body:
The live current corpus can stay stale while the daily workflow records a newer Lovdata manifest. On 2026-09-25, forskrift/2026-09-18-1871 was absent from the site and forskrift/2019-11-22-1547 remained despite being absent from the fresh consolidated archive.

This change downloads against the selected live manifest, verifies cache content, replaces snapshots from fresh database state, and validates the snapshot before producing output. Deployment checks out the exact generated commit, serves its source receipt, and only acknowledges a manifest after reading that receipt from the public site. Rejected pushes fail without rebasing already-generated outputs. GCS now stages only committed product files before authentication so runtime credentials cannot enter the mirror.

Automatic legacy history regeneration requires ENABLE_LEGACY_HISTORY=true while the history rework is unresolved. Existing generated branches, tags and manual workflow remain. This does not resolve the historical accuracy issues #3–#7 or reader issues #8–#10.

Validation: 213 local checks passed; fresh Lovdata XML produced validated/formatted output including the missing regulation; independent delivery review completed. Live publication and membership readback follow merge.
title: Restore fresh current-law publication with verified source identity
